Params cannot show the first engine. TEMPLATE CHANGE NEEDED: add an optional pass-through engine to the debris feature, e.g. debris:{at:4.55, pass_at:1.0}. The content and sync are now right. gaps.missing: In range mode, the lower bound (lo) and the upper value share one reveal beat (countAt). The lo value cannot appear on its own word before the upper value, and with from=lo the upper slot shows the misleading intermediate '1,2 bis 1×' at full opacity before it rolls.
gaps.suggestion: Add a separate loAt beat, and keep the hi slot, separator and unit hidden until countAt (or show only unlit ghost digits there). Alternatively, start the hi counter from lo with its own decimals, so the transient reads as '1,2 bis 1,2'.

gaps.missing: The unlit ghost digits ('8'/'88') before countAt cannot be turned off. In s13_b a faint '8' shows for 1.5 s, in a scene where an 8-fach statement was just cut from the narration.
gaps.suggestion: Add a ghost:false param, or a ghost glyph option such as '0' or segment outlines.

gaps.missing: There is no scene-specific illustration: graphic 'silhouette_on_scale' (a person on a scale with a rising needle) is ignored.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional small side pictogram slot (silhouette on scale, rope, cabin) linked to the gauge progress.

gaps.missing: Only one sublabel and one footnote can carry sequential caveats. There is no list of timed caption lines for scenes that add 2 or more qualifiers one after another.
gaps.suggestion: Add a 'notes': [{text, at}] array rendered as stacked small lines under the label.

gaps.missing: While counting up to a 2-digit value, the single-digit phase sits off-centre, with a visible gap between the ≥ prefix and the digit.
gaps.suggestion: Centre the visible digits dynamically while leading slots are blank, or let the prefix track the leftmost visible digit.

gaps.missing: When a label is set, p.text (on_screen_text) is only drawn if it is used as a kicker (kicker:true). An overlay that is not a name plate cannot be shown alongside a label.
gaps.suggestion: Add a textPos option (kicker | label | hidden), or document that on_screen_text should be empty or equal to the kicker for this template.

gaps.missing: A second visual for comparisons: the storyboard's energy bars (tiny 'Auslegung' bar vs huge 'nach 10 m freiem Fall' bar). The gauge can only show one number.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional 'compare' param, e.g. {bars:[{label,value},{label,value}], at}. It would draw two horizontal bars on a shared scale, beside or under the gauge, each growing in at its own time.

gaps.missing: Full layouts (kicker + label + sublabel + footnote) fill y 96-897, so any scaled camera (slow_push_in, slow_pull_out, pan, tilt: 1.08-1.1) moves the footnote into the subtitle zone (about 910-916 px). All four scenes had to use a static camera.
gaps.suggestion: Make the layout camera-aware: read p.scene.camera, and for scaled cameras shrink the block so that the scaled bottom stays at or above 905 px (for example BOT about 860 and top about 130).

gaps.missing: Setting 'max' always labels both scale ends. With max:30 (a stopwatch face), '30' shows from 0.4 s, long before it is spoken at 8.36 s.
gaps.suggestion: Add 'scaleLabels': false | {at: seconds}, so the range can be set without labels, or the labels can be timed.

gaps.missing: No stair or clock icon and no periodic icon flash (storyboard: 'bei jedem Umlauf leuchtet ein Treppen-Icon auf'). Before the count starts, the number slot only shows unlit 88 digits, which is 8 s in this scene.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional 'icon' param (stairs, clock, person) drawn in the dial before the count, which flashes on each loop ping. Alternatively allow a 'preValue' text in the number slot before [1].

gaps.missing: The label always wipes in from the centre, so its middle and end words appear before its first word. A key word at the end of a label (here 'Treppenunfall') can show about 0.35 s before it is spoken.
gaps.suggestion: Add labelReveal: 'center' | 'ltr' (left-to-right wipe), or word-level 'at' timing for label lines.

gaps.missing: When the sublabel is timed before the label, the divider and sublabel appear under an empty label area for several seconds.
gaps.suggestion: If the sublabel starts before the label, draw it in the label position (or hide the divider) until the label arrives, then slide it down.

gaps.missing: The scene-specific graphic 'silhouette_on_scale' (a person on a scale inside the car) is still not supported. The range band on the gauge stands in for it.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional small silhouette-on-scale icon inside the gauge, or use a template that shows the car, if the storyboard insists on the silhouette.

gaps.missing: While counting, a 1-digit value sits in the ones slot, half a digit right of centre, until the tens digit rolls in (odometer behaviour). This is not a problem with a prefix above the number, and a left prefix now moves up to the digit, but the number block itself does not re-centre.
gaps.suggestion: Optionally centre on the visible digits while counting (slide x0 the same way as the new prefix-hug offset), if reviewers ask for it.

gaps.missing: Edge case: when 'from' is negative and there is a left prefix, the reserved minus slot still leaves a gap once the value is positive. The new prefix hug is turned off when negative numbers are involved. No real scene uses this.
gaps.suggestion: Also make the minus slot and the prefix move up to the first visible digit when the value is negative.

gaps.missing: Explicit beats[0]=0 (and any panel at=0) is clamped to 0.3 s, so passing the documented default 0 delays the panel entrance and leaves the first 0.3 s empty.
gaps.suggestion: Clamp beats[0] and panel.at to [0, d-0.3] instead of [0.3, d-0.3], or treat 0 as 'use default'.

gaps.missing: beats[3] ties the winner highlight to the side strike. There is no separate global highlightAt/strikeAt, so I needed strike:false plus per-point strikeAt as a workaround.
gaps.suggestion: Add params highlightAt and strikeAt (defaulting to beats[3]).

gaps.missing: An analogy panel cannot show a placeholder or frame before its title and visual. Delaying the second analogy until it is spoken leaves half the screen empty for ~3 s, and entering it early would show 'Kettenkarussell' before it is said.
gaps.suggestion: Add panel.titleAt/contentAt (the frame enters at panel.at, and the title and icon come later), or a 'ghost' entrance state with dimmed chrome and a '?' placeholder.

gaps.missing: The stat frame appears at tVis with nothing in it until stat.at, and the unit suffix always appears together with the number, so it cannot follow the spoken unit word.
gaps.suggestion: Draw a dim placeholder ('– – cm/s') or delay the frame reveal to about stat.at-0.3, and add stat.suffixAt.

gaps.missing: When one panel has a text row and the other has none (visual only), the second panel keeps an empty strip at the bottom. The bar axis tick labels (up to '12 m') are visible long before the first height is spoken.
gaps.suggestion: Vertically centre the visual in a panel without rows (or stretch the bar box), and add bar.axisAt to fade the tick labels in with the first value.

gaps.missing: The overlay (on_screen_text box) always appears at 0.5 s. A caveat like 'Nur rekonstruiert' (spoken at 2.75 s) or 'Soweit rekonstruierbar' (s35_b, spoken at 5.07 s) cannot be timed to its words.
gaps.suggestion: Add params.textAt (seconds) to control when the overlay slides in, clamped to [0.3, d−0.8].

gaps.missing: The heading entrance is fixed at about 0.15·k s and cannot be delayed. The chip tag has no own time and only follows the panel entrance.
gaps.suggestion: Add headingAt, plus tagAt per panel.

gaps.missing: stat.label fades in together with the number, so a label spoken later ('ernsthafte Verletzungen' comes 0.8 s after 'siebzehntausend') appears early. I worked around it with separate points. The count-up also shows odd intermediate values (e.g. 931.371) for a spoken 'über eine Million'.
gaps.suggestion: Add stat.labelAt, and a stat.count option ('none' for a fade/pop without counting, or 'rounded' steps).

gaps.missing: highlight is a winner/loser verdict: it always dims the other panel by 20%. Moving the viewer's focus to the panel being narrated ('Wer?' → 'Woran?') without implying a loser is not possible.
gaps.suggestion: Add a focus mode, e.g. focus:[{side,at}], that glows one panel without dimming the other, or add a highlightDim:false flag.

gaps.missing: A point is revealed as one unit. An enumeration spoken over 1.1 s ('Becken, Rücken und Hals gebrochen') cannot build word by word or phrase by phrase.
gaps.suggestion: Allow point.parts: [{text, at}] that append inline within one row.

gaps.missing: The people visual is capped at 184 px high and the bracket label is small (24 px or less). In a text-heavy layout the silhouettes are rather small for the key message ('die Hälfte arbeitete dort').
gaps.suggestion: Allow people.size/scale, or raise VH.people when the other panel has no visual, and allow a larger label size.

gaps.missing: The two rotary drawings are not phase-locked. They reach the same speed and dial reading, but the carousel spins up about 2.3 s after the governor, because its title must not come before 'Kettenkarussells'. Both swinging out at the very same moment is only possible if the carousel is on screen from the start (reviewer fallback right.at 0.3).

gaps.missing: Rows sit on shared y-positions, so the lower third of the centred Kabine card has space reserved but empty for its two rows from about 4.4 s until 'wirkte vermutlich wie ein Kolben' at 5.95 s. This is a known limitation.
gaps.suggestion: Possible later improvement: while the panel is solo, shift its visual down to the middle of the free body height and slide it back up as the rows arrive. Not needed to pass.

gaps.missing: A continuation or 'start built' mode. Every element re-animates from scratch: the time clamp is at least 0.3 s, and the axes, panel and title intro always run. A scene that continues the previous graph (same layout) therefore dims and redraws its curve during the 0.6 s crossfade.
gaps.suggestion: Add params.start_state:'done' (or continue:true). Series, reference lines, bands and annotations without their own 'at' would then be fully drawn from t=0, with no intro sweep. Only items with 'at' would animate.

gaps.missing: Blink and the label cannot be timed separately. blink starts when the marker pops, and the sub line is only 18 px mono. So a marker cannot stay visible from the start and then blink or show a big number on cue. I had to drop the 'spätestens' label for the first 2.5 s.
gaps.suggestion: Add annotations[i].blink_at, plus a way to make the delayed sub line large (sub_size, or label2 at 24 px).

gaps.missing: Annotation label boxes always stack from the top of the plot. The 'gut 11 cm' box sits at the 60 cm level, about 330 px above its point near the bottom, joined only by the dashed marker.
gaps.suggestion: Add a placement preference such as annotations[i].place:'near'|'top'|'above'|'below'. With 'near', scan outwards from the point's own y first.

gaps.missing: Reference-line and y_band labels are fixed at 19 px. The narrated key values ('1/5 g: ein Fünftel', '1 g: volle Erdbeschleunigung', 'Obergrenze: 1,5 m/s') come out small next to the 24 px annotation labels.
gaps.suggestion: Add ref_lines[i].size or emphasis:true (for example 24 px bold in a box).

gaps.missing: The y_unit is only added when the unit text does not already appear inside y_label, and the check is a plain substring match. So 'Verzögerung' plus y_unit 'g' shows no unit, because 'Verzögerung' contains the letter g.
gaps.suggestion: Check only for an existing ' in <unit>', '(unit)' or '[unit]' ending (unitFrom), not for the unit anywhere in the label.

gaps.missing: The overlay always appears at a fixed 0.5 s and is upper-cased, so units become 'M/S' or 'MS'. An overlay therefore cannot be synced to a later word, and it cannot safely carry a number with a unit.
gaps.suggestion: Add a params.text_at (or overlay_at) delay, and keep unit tokens (m/s, ms, cm, g) in their original case when upper-casing.

gaps.missing: The engine does not tell a template anything about the previous scene. With carry_in, phase-matching the blinks, rings and light sweeps needs hand-computed negative at values (at_new = at_old − previous duration), and carry_in needs the previous duration as a number.
gaps.suggestion: Pass the previous scene (its template, params, duration) to p in engine.js, e.g. p.prev. Then carry_in:true could derive the offsets itself.

gaps.missing: During the first 0.3 s of the 0.6 s crossfade the engine renders the incoming scene frozen at t=0 (t = max(0, T − start)), so the incoming layer's ambient motion (blink, dust) stands still for those 0.3 s.
gaps.suggestion: Let the engine pass the negative tRaw (or render the incoming scene at T − start without clamping) so continuation templates can animate through the whole crossfade.

gaps.missing: The graph panel has a fixed size for scale 1.0 (bottom at y 904). Any zoom camera (slow_pull_out, slow_push_in, pan and tilt at 1.08) pushes it into the overlay box and the subtitle zone. Only 'static' is safe.
gaps.suggestion: Add a camera-safe layout mode (a smaller PANEL when scene.camera zooms, e.g. inset by 5 %), or have the engine limit zoom for templates that declare fullFrame:true.

gaps.missing: Same fixed-panel and zoom-camera conflict as s15_a; worked around with the static camera.
gaps.suggestion: Same as s15_a: a camera-aware panel inset or an engine-side zoom limit.

gaps.missing: The big headline readout is always m/s (140 px). The km/h result the narration actually speaks ('über 250 km/h', '≈ 160') is squeezed into a ~186 px cell, so 'über 250' renders at about 62 px, and 'mehr als 250' would be even smaller. The unspoken 72,8 / 44,3 m/s dominates the payoff frame.
gaps.suggestion: Add `primary_unit: "kmh"`, or `headline: "kmh"`, to swap the cells so km/h (or the result_label) is the big number and m/s the small one. Alternatively add `hide_ms: true`.

gaps.missing: The time scale is constant, so the live km/h counter cannot pause or linger on a marker value. At the spoken 'fünfzig' the live readout already shows 57–61 km/h; only the frozen chip says ≈ 50.
gaps.suggestion: Add `markers[i].hold` (s) to briefly slow the time factor around a marker pass (variable time scale). Or add a per-marker option that keeps the km/h cell showing the marker value for N seconds.

gaps.missing: Between impact (beat [1]) and the result crossfade, the exact live value (262 km/h / 159 km/h) always flashes for about 0,2–0,45 s, even when result_label is meant to replace it.
gaps.suggestion: Add an option `result_at_impact: true` that shows result_label directly at impact with no exact-value frame, or let beat [2] = beat [1] mean an instant swap.

gaps.missing: The ruler only shows metres, and its fixed tick labels are visible from the start (e.g. '250' on the 0–300 m scale, a different quantity from the spoken 250 km/h). There is no floor scale for 'rund 75 Stockwerke'.
gaps.suggestion: Add `ruler_unit: "floors"` with `floor_height_m` (e.g. 3,6), to label the ruler in Stockwerke, or `ruler_labels: false`.

gaps.missing: The air-resistance note and panel title fade in with the build-in (~0,8 s) and cannot be timed to the spoken word ('rechnerisch' at 2,95 s).
gaps.suggestion: Add `air_label_at` (s) / `title_at` (s), or let `beats` accept an entry for the note.

gaps.missing: The camera zoom (1,08 for tilt/pan, 1,1 for push/pull) is not compensated. The panel's right edge reaches about 1908 px, the pit and SCHACHTGRUBE fall into the 170 px subtitle band, and TRAGSEIL GERISSEN fades out under the overlay. Both scenes therefore had to use a static camera.
gaps.suggestion: Scale the layout by 1/zoom (or inset margins) when a camera move is active, or offer a template-internal gentle drift that respects the 90 px margins and the subtitle band.

gaps.missing: Between the hold at 10 m and the impact, the live km/h counter runs continuously from 50 to 159 during 'Nach hundert Metern wären es etwa'. The exact 159 then shows for about 0,25 s at impact before '≈ 160' replaces it.
gaps.suggestion: Acceptable as is: it is a continuous count-up and 159 ≈ 160. If needed, add an option that shows the rounded value at the moment of impact when result coincides with impact.

gaps.missing: When the overlay covers the shaft and the car starts at the top of the ruler, only about 40 px of intact rope is visible above the car. After the snap, the upper rope end retracts fully under the box, and only the red dot at the snap point stays visible.
gaps.suggestion: Acceptable. The alternative would be moving the whole shaft graphic lower, which costs ruler height.

gaps.missing: breakRope snaps only one of the 4 ropes. The narration says 'Wir kappen gleich in Gedanken alle Seile', and there is no way to cut all ropes or a chosen number of them.
gaps.suggestion: Add breakRope:"all" or breakCount:n (with optional per-rope stagger), for example the car-side ropes snapping one after another about 0,08 s apart, each with its own sparks and a single SEILBRUCH label. Optionally add carFall:true to let the car drop after an all-rope break.

gaps.missing: The stopwatch readout always scrambles its digits for about 0,6 s after appearing. Single frames then show random, unnarrated values such as '0,048 s' before settling on '0,000 s'.
gaps.suggestion: Add stopwatch.decode:false, or scramble with non-numeric glyphs such as '–,––– s' or block characters instead of random digits, so no frame ever shows a plausible wrong time.

gaps.missing: Blueprint part labels are fixed at 15 px mono with alpha 0,7. On a 1080p YouTube frame, labels such as FANGVORRICHTUNG and SEILBRUCH are barely readable, although the narration relies on them ('keine Sicherung griff').
gaps.suggestion: Add labelSize (for example 15–24) and labelAlpha params, or an emphasis flag per label ({part:'fang', emphasis:true}) that draws that label larger and in amber.

gaps.missing: In layout 'left' the GESCHWINDIGKEITSBEGRENZER label (side −1) is always filtered out because it overlaps the text block. There is also no 'puffer' part. A recap of the whole safety chain (Begrenzer → Fangvorrichtung → Puffer, plus Bremse) can therefore only label Bremse and Fangvorrichtung.
gaps.suggestion: Let a label spec override its side ({part:'begrenzer', side:'right'}) so it routes to the right column. Add a 'puffer' part (with the view or blueprintScale able to include the pit), or add labels:'chain' as a preset for the safety chain.

gaps.missing: Label keyword bug: partOf() matches by substring, so the English part name 'spring' matches the ring part's keyword 'ring'. {"part":"spring"} is silently read as the ring label and dropped as a duplicate, so no 'Feder' tag appears.
gaps.suggestion: In partOf(), check exact pd.id matches for all parts before running the substring keyword loop, or match whole words only. Workaround used: part 'feder'.

gaps.missing: From about 3.4 s to 6.0 s ('Das ist reine Mechanik') nothing new happens in the mechanism itself. There is no dedicated visual for 'rein mechanisch', such as briefly highlighting all the mechanical load-path parts (flyweight, spring, pawl, ring, clamp) as one chain.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional beat or param such as mech_chain_at: a travelling amber glow along flyweight → pawl → ring → rope → clamp with an optional small caption. Workaround used: a 'Feder' tag timed to 'reine Mechanik'.

gaps.missing: 'lässt ein Schalter die Bremse einfallen' is shown only as the switch opening, 'Motor aus' and a text line. The drive brake itself is never shown engaging.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional small brake glyph in the switch panel (brake shoes closing on a drum, with an amber flash at [1]+0.3 s), e.g. show_brake:true.

gaps.missing: A card's label and subline always appear together. The subline cannot have its own 'at', so a two-part message timed to two phrases ('reine Mechanik' … 'ohne Strom') cannot be staged in one card.
gaps.suggestion: Support no_power_icon.sub_at (and analogy.sub_at) so the subline fades in separately.

gaps.missing: If a clamp label's 'at' is less than labDur before beat [3], the tag box briefly shows 'Seilklemme' and then flips to 'Seil geklemmt', which reads as a flicker.
gaps.suggestion: When the label reveal overlaps [3] by less than about 0.3 s, show hot_text from the start (or cross-fade the two texts). Workaround used: set the clamp text to 'Seil geklemmt'.

gaps.missing: The scope line ('für alle, die nicht am Aufzug arbeiten', spoken at 1.8 to 3.3 s) can only appear inside the result tile together with the result label. It cannot be shown in sync with its words before the result.
gaps.suggestion: Add scope_at (or a separate BEATS entry) so the scope line appears on its own, for example under the counter, before the result tile.

gaps.missing: The decade ladder shows its end label 10^exp from the first frame, and the counter shows '1 von 10 Fahrten' at the start. The target magnitude is partly visible before it is spoken.
gaps.suggestion: Option to reveal ladder labels only when the marker passes them, and to hide or dim the counter word until beats[1].

gaps.missing: The readout tile's hanging-load symbol shows the unit glyph 't' as soon as the tile appears (beats[1]), before 'Tonnen' is spoken at beats[2].
gaps.suggestion: Show the unit glyph with the value beat, or add then_readout.symbol ('t' | 'F' | '') so it can be neutral until the value.

gaps.missing: items[].dim_at starts the dimension line; the dimension text only appears about 0.5 s later (55 % of dimDur). The actual text time is not obvious from the API note 'dimension appears'.
gaps.suggestion: Make dim_at the time the dimension text is readable, or document the offset (text ≈ dim_at + 0.55·dimDur).

gaps.missing: With then_readout, the layout reserves the tile column from t=0. The rope and pencil sit left of centre and the right third stays empty for 6.6 s until the tile appears.
gaps.suggestion: Centre the objects across the full width until the tile beat, then ease them left, or allow a readout layout option 'below'.

gaps.missing: With ownsText the overlay always appears at 0.5 s. Any number or result in on_screen_text is revealed before it is spoken, so overlays have to be generic.
gaps.suggestion: Support params.text_at (seconds) so the overlay can be timed to a word, for example the key number.

gaps.missing: Unsupported key 'reference' (known). The layout below y≈860 ('cm' label at 892, 'Führungsschiene' at 868) enters the subtitle zone under any camera zoom or tilt, so the scene has to use a static camera.
gaps.suggestion: Raise the vertical_ruler geometry (y1) by about 40 px so camera moves stay above y 910.

gaps.missing: The readout panel (panel1) always shows example numbers: speed tile, live g values, BREMSWEG mm and the a(t) chart with the 'zulässig Ø 0,2-1,0 g' band. It has no option to show only the title and status. Turning it off (panel:false) leaves the whole upper-right quadrant empty, and the energy panel or label card stays in the lower slot (P2Y=645).
gaps.suggestion: Add a numberless panel mode (e.g. readouts:"title"/"status", or hideValues:true) showing only the title, subtitle, status pill and an optional unlabelled a(t) curve. Or, when panel:false, move or vertically centre panel2 (energy, label, topview) so the right half stays balanced.

gaps.missing: Energy bars follow v²/2, so the kinetic bar is about 75% gone halfway through braking. When the narration describes the conversion mid-braking ('verwandelt die Bewegungsenergie'), the panel is already mostly drained as it appears.
gaps.suggestion: Add an option such as energyEase:"linear" or an energyAt window, so the bars can be animated across a given time span independently of the physics profile.

gaps.missing: Every non-static camera (push x1.1, tilt/pan x1.08) pushes the right-hand panels to x≈1900-1917. With tilt, the lever bar or label reaches the subtitle band (y≈908-941). The layout spans about 160-1844 px, which is too wide for any zoom within the 90 px margins, so the storyboard cameras slow_push_in and tilt_up had to become static.
gaps.suggestion: Add a compact layout option (e.g. layout:"compact" or a margin param) that scales or insets the whole composition by about 0.9 so camera moves stay inside 90 px margins and above the subtitle band.

gaps.missing: With bidirectional:true and panel:false, the upward overspeed before arrowsAt is shown only by unlabelled red chevrons. drawDirection skips the 'Fahrt' label in bi mode, and the 'ÜBERGESCHW. AUFWÄRTS' status only lives in the disabled panel.
gaps.suggestion: Draw a small 'Fahrt aufwärts' or 'ÜBERGESCHW. AUFWÄRTS' tag next to the chevrons when the panel is off (or always in bi mode before the double arrow appears).

gaps.missing: The energy panel's footnote ('Wärme = Bewegungs- + Lageenergie der Bremsstrecke') cannot be hidden, so it adds a fact that is not in the narration.
gaps.suggestion: Add an energyNote:false (or energyFootnote string) param.

gaps.missing: The energy panel always shows the real energy state (it falls with v²). When the panel appears late (panel2At 3.2 s, mid-braking), the kinetic bar is already about 35% drained at fade-in, and nothing can start the energy animation at the moment the panel appears.
gaps.suggestion: Leave as is, because it is physically honest. If wanted, add an option such as energyFrom:'reveal' that eases the bars from full kinetic energy to the live state over about 0.5 s after panel2At.

gaps.missing: The comparison-mode principle chip (ENERGIESPEICHERND / ENERGIEVERZEHREND) cannot be hidden. mode:"" falls back to the default, and the chip colour stays fixed per type, so the hydraulic chip is red even when it only says HYDRAULIK. This forces unspoken facts, or a red 'danger' colour, onto the oil buffer.
gaps.suggestion: Support buffers[i].mode:false or a global show_mode:false to hide the chip. Add buffers[i].mode_color (amber|cyan|green|red|#hex) and mode_at so the principle can be revealed when it is spoken.

gaps.missing: The dimension caption cannot be switched off (the workaround is caption:" "). With short strokes (7 cm at 1 m/s), the caption placed at ym-24 moves above the bracket and onto the Fahrkorb beam.
gaps.suggestion: Accept caption:false or "". Place the caption below the value (or next to the note) when the bracket is shorter than about 60 px.

gaps.missing: The speed tag '↓ 1 m/s' stays static on the car while it hovers, while it rests compressed and while the spring car rebounds upward. The down arrow then contradicts the visible motion, and the tag cannot be told apart as rated speed.
gaps.suggestion: Add speed_until or an option to fade the tag after touch-down. Optionally allow a caption such as 'Nenngeschw.' so the tag reads as rated speed rather than current speed.

gaps.missing: In side_by_side mode every car hovers motionless from about 0.15 s until shortly before its hit_at, so the second car waits about 3.5 s with no motion.
gaps.suggestion: Add a gentle idle (slow creep or a slight bob), or an option for a car to enter from above just before its hit, while the buffers stay visible from the start.

gaps.missing: Under pan or tilt cameras (scale 1.08), the label chips at M_LABEL_Y=855 reach about y 907, which touches the subtitle-reserved zone (bottom 170 px, y > 910).
gaps.suggestion: Move M_LABEL_Y up by about 15 px, or reduce the gap between the floor and the chips, so there is a margin under the 1.08–1.1 camera scales.

gaps.missing: While the overlay fades in at about 0.7 s, the text briefly sticks out of its growing box. The engine draws this overlay, not the template.
gaps.suggestion: Fix in engine.js: clip or delay the overlay text until the box has finished growing. This cannot be fixed inside buffer.js.

gaps.missing: The balance panel draws the counterweight pan label 'Kabine + a–b %', the load-bar label 'Ausgleich a–b %' and 'BELADUNG 0 %' as soon as the panel opens, with no separate timing. The scale cannot appear on 'so schwer wie' (2.2 s) without giving away '40–50 %' before 'vierzig' (4.32 s), so the panel had to open late.
gaps.suggestion: Time-gate the numeric pan and bar labels, either with the rest of the equation (tEq2 / beat 2) or with a new `numbers_at` override. Until then show the counterweight pan as 'Gegengewicht' only.

gaps.missing: In balance mode the right column stays completely empty until balance_at, because grooves and inset are ignored. When the panel has to open late, the right half of the frame is empty for about 4 s right after s07_b's insets fade out.
gaps.suggestion: Allow the grooves/towel insets (or a slim placeholder) in balance mode until balance_at, then slide them out as the panel slides in, e.g. `hold_insets_until` or `inset_out_at`.

gaps.missing: The part of the equation after '+' always types over a fixed 0.8 s, so the last word ('Nutzlast') appears about 0.9 s before it is spoken. It cannot be spread over the spoken phrase.
gaps.suggestion: Add `equation_rest_duration` (seconds), or per-word 'at' times for the equation.

gaps.missing: During the load ramp the counter and the car-pan label show intermediate percentages that are not in the narration (e.g. '+ 1 % Last', '3 %').
gaps.suggestion: Add an option to hide the numeric readout while the ramp runs and show only the target value once it is reached (e.g. `load_readout: 'final'`).

gaps.missing: The groove inset caption ('Sitzrille mit Unterschnitt' / 'Keilrille' / 'Rundrille (Sitzrille)') cannot be hidden, so a technical term not in the narration always appears. The towel inset also hard-codes the weight labels 'Kabine' and 'Gegengewicht', which introduces the counterweight one scene before the narration names it.
gaps.suggestion: Add `groove_caption: false|string` and `towel_labels: [left,right] | false`.

gaps.missing: The 'sheave' callout anchor sits on the rope wrap at 212° on radius R, so the 'Treibscheibe' dot lands on the ropes rather than on the sheave body. Only the box position (x,y) can be overridden, not the anchor point.
gaps.suggestion: Anchor 'sheave' on the sheave face (e.g. a spoke or the hub), or accept `px/py` anchor overrides in labels.

gaps.missing: The balance-mode panel still cannot open before beat 0 without showing the counterweight highlight. So between the end of the crossfade (about 0.3 s) and 1.35 s, the right column is empty and the picture is the s07_b end pose.
gaps.suggestion: Accept this. It is about 1 s while 'Am anderen Ende hängt das' is spoken, and the counterweight is introduced on beat 0. If needed later, a separate panel_at param could open the panel frame earlier and keep the counterweight highlight on beats[0].

gaps.missing: Several notes on one row are chained horizontally, never stacked vertically. A second note on the Fang row would run out of width, so the contrast 'statt schlaffes Seil' had to go on another row (Tragseile).
gaps.suggestion: Add a note placement option such as 'stack:"below"|"above"' (or automatic vertical stacking when the chained x would exceed box.x1 - 250), which puts the note under the previous note on the same row with a short connector.

gaps.missing: Chained notes on a short-card row reach the right safe edge after two notes (right edge ≈1828 px). There is no way to replace or hide an earlier note (no 'until'/'out' time), so the Puffer row cannot carry a third fact.
gaps.suggestion: Support notes[i].until (fade out) or 'replace:true' (the new note takes the previous note's slot on that row). Also add vertical stacking as above.

gaps.missing: Outline mode always shows every card label from the moment the plate appears. There is no way to show the empty roadmap with neutral placeholders and reveal each name when the layer is named or lit, so all six layer names are visible before they are introduced.
gaps.suggestion: Add 'label_reveal':"with_light" (card shows only the number or '?' until tLit) or a per-layer 'label_at'.

gaps.missing: The newest sync pulse holds amber indefinitely, with no release time. Two layers cannot hold amber together through sync alone. A workaround was needed: an extra pulse on Begrenzer to clear the hold on Prüfungen, plus emphasis for Fang.
gaps.suggestion: Add 'sync_hold': seconds (or false) and allow the same 'at' for several sync items to share the hold. Alternatively add 'focus':[refs] with 'at' to set a group amber focus.

gaps.missing: The heritage start caption 'Sperre von Otis' fades out at heritage.at+0.8…1.3 s, exactly while the words are usually spoken during the flight. Caption timing and flight start cannot be set separately.
gaps.suggestion: Add heritage.fly_at (flight start) and keep the start caption visible until the flight begins, or add heritage.label_at.

gaps.missing: Note fitting always breaks after ':' / '.' / ';' when the text has two parts. 'etwa: Steuerung versagt' was forced into two unbalanced lines although it fits on one line at 23 px. 'z. B. …' would also split after 'z.'.
gaps.suggestion: Only use the sentence-part split when the one-line fit fails. Ignore abbreviations such as 'z. B.', 'ca.', 'bzw.' in the split regex.

gaps.missing: There is no visual for a single common-cause event hitting two layers, such as a red strike or impact line running through both plates at once. The template can only put layers out and attach a label.
gaps.suggestion: Add a params.impact option: {layers:[…], at}. It would draw a short red diagonal strike or shockwave through the listed plates at 'at', followed by their extinguish.

gaps.missing: There is no 'hypothetical failure' state, meaning 'would have to fail' as opposed to 'failed'. Red emphasis is the closest option, but it looks the same as a real alarm.
gaps.suggestion: Add tone:'hypo' or a state 'at_risk': a red dashed outline that pulses, with the plate still lit and no ×.

gaps.missing: An overlay that summarises a later-spoken fact gives it away early, because the engine always shows the overlay text at 0.5–0.75 s. So the overlay has to stay neutral.
gaps.suggestion: Add an engine-level scene.text_at (or per-scene overlay delay) so the overlay can appear together with its key word.

gaps.missing: In static scenes the stack and cards take up only the left ~55–60% of the frame, so the right third stays empty unless there are notes. In a 3 s scene the cascade also leaves roughly the first 0.4 s nearly blank.
gaps.suggestion: Add a params.align option ('center' | 'left') or auto-centre the stack+card block when no notes are defined.

gaps.missing: The font size of notes and labels is fixed at about 20–27 px and cannot be changed, which is small for key recap words on a 1080p YouTube frame.
gaps.suggestion: Add params.note_scale (for example 1.0–1.3), applied when there is enough horizontal space.

gaps.missing: The heritage (Otis) icon has a fixed dock position (cx+0.38A, just above the plate centre), so it always covers the front corner of the plate above. The docked caption is always placed to the right of the icon and is not collision-checked against the card column. Only a short label (e.g. 'Otis-Sperre') keeps it clear.
gaps.suggestion: Clamp the docked caption's right edge to cardX-8k. If it does not fit there, shrink it down to 17k or move it above the icon. Optionally add a heritage.dock offset param [dx,dy] so the icon can be lowered onto the front half of the plate.

gaps.missing: When a sync pulse's amber hold ends, it fades out over 0.5 s through hot white (hotMix). A layer that is leaving focus briefly looks whitish instead of going straight back to cyan, which can pull the eye in fast pulse sequences.
gaps.suggestion: Add an optional sync_hold_fade param, e.g. 0.25 s. Or fade the hold directly from amber to cyan (mix instead of hotMix) when the layer stays lit.

gaps.missing: Two notes cannot be stacked on the same row: every row has one right-hand slot, so a second note goes further right or runs out of space. Contrast pairs such as 'reagiert auf X / statt Y' therefore have to be split across different layers.
gaps.suggestion: Let notes set stack:true to go under the previous note on the same row (offset by nt.h + 8k) when the vertical space between the rows allows it.

gaps.missing: There is no way to ping or highlight a target (for example the Begrenzer switch at 'Schalter am Begrenzer', 0,6–1,8 s) without adding a status card, so the switch is not emphasised while it is named, only when it opens.
gaps.suggestion: Add params.highlights: [{target, at, color}] that uses the same ping() effect without a card.

gaps.missing: Motor off, magnet dark and switch opening are all tied to beats[0], so the motor stops about 1 s before 'Motor aus' is spoken. Because the brake has to fall in at 'Bremse zu', the arms also stay open for about 1,3 s after the magnet goes dark.
gaps.suggestion: Add optional motor_off_at / magnet_off_at, defaulting to beats[0], so the circuit opening, motor stop and magnet de-energising can be timed separately.

gaps.missing: With slow_push_in, the hatching under the base plate (BASE_Y+30) ends at about y 912, 2 px into the 170 px subtitle band.
gaps.suggestion: Move BASE_Y up by about 10 px, or shorten the hatch, when the camera scales up.

gaps.missing: The engine cannot delay when the overlay text appears: drawOverlayText always fades in at 0.5 s. A scene whose headline is spoken late therefore has to move the headline onto a timed card, which is what this scene does now.
gaps.suggestion: Add an engine-level scene param such as text_at (seconds) to drawOverlayText. That is outside this template.

gaps.missing: A label callout cannot share the screen with the magnifier. The counter panel always sits above the magnifier (y>=208), and the callout box above the rope overlaps it once the magnifier travels under the callout. The callout also does not dodge the magnifier circle itself, and there is no way to fade the label out when the magnifier opens.
gaps.suggestion: Add a `label_until` (or `label_hide_on_scan: true`) so the callout fades before the magnifier opens. Or add magnifier-circle and readout-path avoidance to drawCallout, for example flipping the box below the rope or to the far side of the magnifier path.

gaps.missing: Nothing carries the inspection state over from the previous scene. s24_c re-opens the magnifier from zero at the far left and re-counts the 3 breaks that s24_b already counted and ringed, so the crossfade briefly shows two magnifiers in different places.
gaps.suggestion: Add `initial_counted` N, so the leftmost N breaks start with rings and count as already filled, and `lens_open_at_start: true` or `lens_start_u`, so the magnifier starts already open at a given rope position.

gaps.missing: When the magnifier starts at the left, the readout panel is forced to the top (y=208), right under the engine overlay box (about 38 px gap). No param moves the readout, for example below the magnifier or to its side.
gaps.suggestion: Add `readout_side`: 'above' | 'below' | 'auto'. 'auto' would place the panel below the magnifier when it would sit within 60 px of the overlay zone (y<250, x<900).

gaps.missing: The template can't read the previous scene. The engine keeps the timeline private, so carry has to repeat s24_b's params, duration and camera by hand. They can drift apart if s24_b is retuned.
gaps.suggestion: Have engine.js pass p.prev = {template, params, d, camera} (the previous scene) into draw(). rope_macro could then use it automatically whenever the previous template is also rope_macro.

gaps.missing: No engine camera starts at exactly the transform s24_b ends on (scale 1.08, x shifted +60). slow_pull_out starts at 1.1, so labels, rings and the lens rim show a faint 2% ghost during the 0.6 s crossfade.
gaps.suggestion: Add an engine camera option with a configurable start scale and offset (e.g. camera 'hold_then_pull_out' or params.camera_from {s, dx, dy}). The cut would then match pixel for pixel.

gaps.missing: With carry, the number of new breaks that fit cleanly is limited: they must sit ahead of the lens, clear of the lens rim and off the stamp axis. For this layout that is 4. More are placed in looser spots or dropped (e.g. 24 requested gives 15).
gaps.suggestion: Accept the limit, or let the rope scroll further under a stationary lens (e.g. an optional larger rope pan in carry scenes) to open more room.

gaps.missing: No way to show a second, separately timed fact about the same person (here 'schwere Verbrennungen' at 4.82 s after 'Liftführerin' at 2.31 s): one label per anchor. The floor anchor's box is left-aligned at x 480, so any label longer than about 200 px runs into the detail panel and collides with the helpers label.
gaps.suggestion: Add a second person anchor (e.g. 'injury'/'status', box under the person label), or allow a timed panel_title/caption (panel_title_at), and right-align the floor anchor box to the left of the tower marker (or cap its width at about 200 px with wrapping).

gaps.missing: The newspaper note cannot be hidden or timed: highlight_note ''/false falls back to the default text, and the note is readable as soon as the paper slides in. Only the underline is tied to beat[1]. That shows s04_c's content early. The quote plate is small (25 px italic) and its position is fixed at the top right.
gaps.suggestion: Support highlight_note:false plus note_at (the text fades in at a beat), and a quote size/position option, or a 'strike'/'missing' style for the quote.

gaps.missing: distance_sub cannot be cleared with '' (pick() treats '' as missing, so the default 'rund 300 m' for floor 75 comes back); a single space is needed as a workaround. The end of the fall is also tied to beat[3] (dimension line), and a cabin label would collide with the dimension line at x 1150.
gaps.suggestion: Treat distance_sub:false/'' as 'hide'; add a separate beat for the fall end; move the car anchor box to the left of the shaft.

gaps.missing: The plane anchor box is left-aligned at x 440 while its target is to the right, so the leader runs under the box and attaches to its far left edge. Longer texts (e.g. 'amerikanischer Bomber') make the leader cross the text box.
gaps.suggestion: Give the plane anchor align:'right' (box ending left of the target) or attach the leader to the nearest box edge.

gaps.missing: The status chip's first state 'SEIL ZIEHT · SPERRE GELÖST' appears in one piece with the force arrows at beat[0], so 'gelöst' can't be synced separately from 'Seil zieht'. The default title plate 'FANGVORRICHTUNG' overlaps the right post (plate left edge about x 1345 vs post edge 1360).
gaps.suggestion: Split the chip into two lines or parts with their own times (status_at), or allow custom status texts; narrow or reposition the principle title plate.

gaps.missing: slow_push_in scales about the frame centre, so the decorative plate edge and the tower's foundation end up at about y 915-935 in the last frames. All real content (panel floor at about 903, figures at 848 or higher) stays above 910.
gaps.suggestion: If a reviewer treats decorative edges under the subtitles as a fault, switch the camera to static. The figure animation supplies enough motion; no param change is needed.

gaps.missing: The newspaper variant with the stamp benched 41 ms per frame under load, slightly over the 40 ms idle target and well under the accepted 65 ms. Most of the cost is the glow text shadows.
gaps.suggestion: Acceptable as is. If needed, cache the landed stamp as a sprite after quote_at+0.2 s.

gaps.missing: config caps quote_by at 60 characters and quote at 90, so extremely long texts are truncated. The stamp wraps and the quote gets an ellipsis, so nothing overflows.
gaps.suggestion: Keep stamp texts short, e.g. 'FEHLT IN DEN BERICHTEN'; a first word of 8 characters or fewer is rendered large.

gaps.missing: There is no continue or resume mode. The storyboard wants the LEGENDE stamp to land on 'fehlt dieser Ausruf', but those words are spoken in s04_b, which uses historic_scene. myth_card cannot start with the card and claim already on screen and only stamp at a beat, so the verdict cannot land in a follow-up scene. s04_a therefore ends as a PRÜFE… cliffhanger and the LEGENDE stamp is never shown.
gaps.suggestion: Add `resume:true` (or `typed:true`): card, header and claim fully visible from 0 s, no intro or typing, and only the stamp, mark and explanation run on their beats. s04_b could then be a myth_card continuation, or historic_scene could reuse the stamp renderer.

gaps.missing: In the full-width card layout, the reticle's 'ANALYSE / xx %' label runs across the FAKT divider and label whenever an explanation appears before the stamp (explanationAt < stampAt). Seen in scene-qa2/s20_a_v2 at 5.3 s.
gaps.suggestion: When the explanation is visible before tImp, move the reticle up, shrink it, or fade out its label. Alternatively, lower regBot so the reticle and its label stay above E.divY.

gaps.missing: Typing runs at a fixed rate (typeDur or typeSpeed), so it cannot follow the speech rhythm. In short scenes where the stamp comes right after the last word (s26_a, s04_a), the last words appear 0.3–0.5 s before they are spoken.
gaps.suggestion: Add per-word typing marks, e.g. `typeMarks:[{w:'oben',t:2.94},…]`, or accept word_times directly and type each word from its start time.

gaps.missing: In the film background, the car's fall and the sparks both start at sparksAt. The storyboard beats 'Funken sprühende Schienen' (2.0 s) and 'ungebremst rasende Kabine' (3.7 s) cannot be timed separately.
gaps.suggestion: Add a separate `raceAt` or `fallAt` for the car's motion and speed lines, independent of sparksAt.

gaps.missing: With showStamp:false the reticle still counts up to 'ANALYSE 100 %' while the status stays 'PRÜFE…', which is a little contradictory for a cliffhanger.
gaps.suggestion: When there is no stamp, cap the percentage at about 90–97 % or make it pulse, so the analysis reads as unfinished.

gaps.missing: Only one highlight per scene. The storyboard wants the Begrenzer highlighted during 'löst der Begrenzer aus' and then 'Keile an die Schienen' to glow green as the payoff. Currently Keile can only be bright green, without the glow or brackets.
gaps.suggestion: Allow highlight as an array with per-item times, e.g. highlights:[{i:1,at:6.1},{i:3,at:8.3,tone:'green'}]. The previous highlight would hand over (fade to a normal card) or both stay emphasised.

gaps.missing: The year and label of a card always reveal together (label about 0.1·pop after the year). When the narration says the label before the number ('Seile weg bei null') or long before or after it (s03_a 'Kristallpalast', s27_b 'eigenen Schutz'), one of the two is early or late. The title slot had to be used as a workaround.
gaps.suggestion: Per-event labelAt (and optionally yearAt), or a second 'sub' line with its own 'at' that types in later on the same card.

gaps.missing: The year decode effect flashes wrong numbers for 2–3 frames (e.g. '1999' before '1945', '1099' before '1854'). This can read as a number that is not in the narration.
gaps.suggestion: Add yearFx:'fade'|'type'|'decode' (or decode:false), or decode only characters that differ from the final value while keeping the final digits' leading part stable.

gaps.missing: No custom span or bracket label between two non-numeric events. Gap labels only work between exact numeric years, so '≤ 2 Jahre' between the two Hauptprüfungen had to go into a card's year slot.
gaps.suggestion: gaps as an array of custom spans, e.g. spans:[{from:0,to:2,label:'≤ 2 Jahre',at:5.5}], drawn as a dimension bracket above or below the axis.

gaps.missing: Nothing can animate before the first event or title except the overlay. In scenes whose first timeline fact comes late (s25_a about 2.4 s, s17_a about 2.4 s) the opening frames are sparse.
gaps.suggestion: An optional intro element, e.g. an 'intro' icon/label slot or a slow ambient axis draw (beats[0] with a constant-speed head that does not depend on the first 'at'), so the axis can build evenly from the start without slowing down at the first node.

gaps.missing: While the hero is up (0–5.3 s), the band below the axis stays empty. The hero is always placed in the band between the overlay and the axis (so the axis can build underneath it) and is always horizontally centred. There is no option to centre it on the whole frame or follow the camera focus.
gaps.suggestion: Add a hero placement option, e.g. hero:{place:'center'}, which centres the hero on the frame and fades the ghost rail in only when the hero lifts. Only worth it if a reviewer still finds the lower third too empty.

gaps.missing: The hero sub-line appears as a whole phrase, with no per-word timing. 'DEKRA' shows about 1.7 s before it is spoken (it is spoken at the end of the same phrase).
gaps.suggestion: If needed, add per-word 'at' values for the sub-line (a typewriter reveal by word timestamps).

gaps.missing: The idle reading is fixed in the template: the tacho always counts to min(850, rpm) and holds there until the rpm beat. There is no way to hide the digital readout until the rev-up or to set the idle value, so an unspoken number (850) is on screen for about 0.7 s.
gaps.suggestion: Add rpm.idle (number, 0 allowed) and/or rpm.readoutAt, a time before which the readout is hidden or shows '—'.

gaps.missing: The title's word-by-word reveal uses a fixed stagger of at most 0.07 s per word, so it cannot follow the speech (here 'Was' at 2.01 s to '8.000' at 3.47 s). The whole title had to start at 2.95 s so the number would not show before it is spoken, which puts the first words about 0.9 s after they are heard.
gaps.suggestion: Add a per-word timing array (titleWordTimes) or a titleStagger / titleDuration parameter so the title can be paced to word_times_s.

gaps.missing: The needle overshoot (backOut 0.8) is hard-coded, so the readout briefly shows values up to about 8.150 before settling on the spoken 8.000.
gaps.suggestion: Add rpm.overshoot (0 = none), or clamp the readout at the target value while the needle itself overshoots.

gaps.missing: Title word stagger is fixed at 0.07 s, so 'U/min?' appears about 0.75 s before 'Umdrehungen pro Minute' is spoken. The reviewer accepted this as is.
gaps.suggestion: Optional: per-word 'at' or a titleWordTimes param for the next_title, if exact word sync is ever needed.

gaps.missing: The on-screen title is always drawn by drawTitle from 0.5 s (text at about 0.75 s). There is no way to time it to the narration, so any summary title reveals the scene's result ('überlebt', 'Wie ist das möglich?') 2–3 s early. The same issue forced title changes in s06_a, s07_a and s08_a.
gaps.suggestion: Support params.title_at (seconds or '%') in drawTitle, and maybe title_until, so the overlay can appear with its words.

gaps.missing: The full framing is fixed (building about 630 px wide at x≈1110, no zoom or offset). The right quarter stays empty, and with any engine camera move (tilt/pan/push scale ≥1.08) the machine-room roof goes past the 90 px top margin (about 38–56 px).
gaps.suggestion: Add full_zoom / full_offset_x params, or shrink the full layout by about 8 % so camera moves stay inside the safe margins.

gaps.missing: In focus 'ropes' the camera rect ends at hitchY+70, so unless the car is on the top floor its lower half (people, safety gear) sits in the subtitle band (y>910), and more so with tilt_up or push_in. With a moving car the rect follows the hitch, so the zoom drifts strongly.
gaps.suggestion: Frame ropes focus to car bottom + padding (or clamp the car's screen bottom ≤ 880), and freeze the rect at its t=0 value for moving states (or add ropes_lock:true).

gaps.missing: The HUD speed panel always prints the governor tick '115 %' and 'Nenn x,x'. These numbers may not be narrated yet, so a narrated speed had to go into a static readout instead of the live HUD.
gaps.suggestion: Add hud_marks:false (hide the 115 % and Nenn ticks), or hud_trip_mark_at to reveal the 115 % tick with its narration.

gaps.missing: In machine_room focus the sheave anchor puts left callouts on top of the counterweight rope bundle. A right callout on the ropes or sheave overlaps the governor housing, because boxes are not collision-checked against geometry. There is also no per-label anchor offset.
gaps.suggestion: Collision-check callout boxes against the governor, rope and sheave bounding boxes in close-ups, or accept labels[i].dy / labels[i].anchor ('top'|'mid'|'bottom') and a fixed label_x.

gaps.missing: When both left and right callouts exist in a close-up, chevron avoidance only shifts the right callout box. The chevrons then sit on the car callout's leader line.
gaps.suggestion: Also route the leader around the chevron column, or draw the chevrons below or above the car in close-ups.

gaps.missing: No visual idiom for 'resting loosely, not bolted' (for example a missing-bolt or detached-clamp icon at the rope-sheave contact). The generic ✕ marker was used instead.
gaps.suggestion: Add marker symbol 'unbolted' (crossed-out bolt), or overlay 'no_fixing' at the sheave-rope contact.

gaps.missing: Only one debris path exists: into the shaft, onto the ropes, onto the car roof. The first engine, which 'durchschlägt das ganze Haus', cannot be shown, so the first 3,7 s are a static shaft.
gaps.suggestion: Add a second debris trajectory, e.g. debris:{type:'engine', path:'through', at, floor}. It would cross the building horizontally at a given floor (break in through one outer wall, out through the other) before or next to the shaft entry. Also allow debris as a list.

gaps.missing: When inspection_plate is highlighted, the whole plate including the 'next date' month segment turns the highlight colour, so the date marker loses its contrast. There is also no way to mark a specific month.
gaps.suggestion: Keep the month segment in a contrasting colour when highlighted (e.g. white or green on the amber ring). Add plate_month (1-12) to choose which segment is lit, without printing a year.

gaps.missing: In runaway_up the governor disc turns amber/red automatically once v > 115 % even with trip:false, which is an unnarrated overspeed cue.
gaps.suggestion: Add governor_react:false (or neutral_governor) to keep the governor cyan when the trip is not part of the beat.

gaps.missing: highlight_at is one time for all highlighted parts; the brake could not be highlighted separately at 'versagender Bremse' while the counterweight lights up at 'Gegengewicht'.
gaps.suggestion: Accept per-part timing: highlight:[{part:'counterweight',at:0.6},{part:'brake',at:4.5}].

gaps.missing: There is no label anchor for the passenger silhouette, so 'Körper' has to be anchored on the car wall, and both callouts share one dot.
gaps.suggestion: Add a 'passenger'/'person'/'koerper' part whose anchor follows the (floating) figure.

gaps.missing: safety_engage always shows the red 'AUSGELÖST' chip at the governor from t=0, even when the scene is only about the wedges and rails.
gaps.suggestion: Add trip_chip:false (or make the chip follow highlight/labels on the governor).

gaps.missing: In focus 'ropes' the zoom stays around 1,25x when the car is low enough for a proper debris drop. The rope damage is small, and ~40 % of the frame on both sides is empty.
gaps.suggestion: Add focus 'rope_damage' (or a zoom param) framing the band from the wall-entry point down to the car roof, centred on the damage point.

gaps.missing: In full focus the pit and ground hatching sit around y 900–1000, inside the 170 px subtitle band, and the building leaves the left third of the frame empty.
gaps.suggestion: Raise the full-focus building by ~70 px (or add frame_offset_y) so the pit stays above y 900.

gaps.missing: Callout layout is recomputed every frame in screen space including the engine camera scale. With slow_push_in (or tilt/pan at scale 1.08) a right-side callout in a zoomed focus switches between 'next to anchor' and 'pushed past the direction chevrons' mid-scene when chev.x1+26+w crosses 1830. In v2 the rope-coil callout jumped from x≈1480 to x≈1120 at about 5 s.
gaps.suggestion: Compute the callout lane positions once per scene in the reference camera (without the engine push/tilt), or add hysteresis. Also reserve the chevron lane only while the car is actually moving.

gaps.missing: No label anchor at the air-escape path or the EG door gaps. 'Schacht nicht luftdicht' can only point at the pit corner (part pit) or the hatching (air_cushion).
gaps.suggestion: Add part 'air_escape' / 'door_gap' anchored at the EG door-gap exit point (G.S0-4 or G.S1+4, yEx), side left or right.

gaps.missing: No direct control of callout placement: no x/y offset or lane per label. The rope-coil callout either covers the tension-pulley weight or needs a wording and width tuned so the chevron logic pushes it outside the shaft. Its lead line still crosses the right rail and the tension strut.
gaps.suggestion: Support labels[i].dx/dy or 'lane':'outside' so a callout can be placed outside the shaft wall on purpose, with a lead line that avoids the tension-pulley column.

gaps.missing: No damaged/frayed style for the governor rope. damaged_ropes and broken_style only apply to the suspension ropes, so 'beschädigtes Begrenzerseil' can only be shown as a red highlight, not as a damage point.
gaps.suggestion: Add governor_damage:{at, y} (red flicker plus frayed wires on the governor-rope strand, like damaged_ropes), or accept 'governor_rope' in damaged_ropes.

gaps.missing: Only one highlight_at for all highlighted parts, so parts cannot light up at different words (for example the safety gear at 0.9 s and the governor rope at 6.1 s). Also, the safety_gear '?' marker is placed up and to the right of the anchor, over the car's lower-left corner, instead of beside the wedge.
gaps.suggestion: Allow highlight entries as objects {part, at, color}. Place the marker badge on the outward side of left-side anchors (dx = -36 for side 'left').

gaps.missing: This is from reading the code; I did not render this setup. In focus 'car' the governor_rope anchor is fixed at carY+64, so with the car in the pit (on_buffer) the anchor falls below the tension pulley, into the earth. An aftermath close-up with a governor-rope callout is therefore not possible.
gaps.suggestion: Clamp the governor_rope anchor in car and plate focus to [gy, tpY], for example by using carY-CH*0.5 when carY+64 > tpY.

gaps.missing: The safety_factor chip is always placed left of the car-side rope, where in focus 'ropes' it covers the counterweight-side rope run. There is no side option, and the caption is fixed at 15 px.
gaps.suggestion: Add safety_factor.side ('left'|'right') and snap it to the callout column on the right when right is chosen. Allow a caption size of 18–20 px.

gaps.missing: Full focus has a fixed scale (the building is the full frame height), so the seated passenger stays about 15×40 px.
gaps.suggestion: Optional full_zoom param that crops the machine room or pit when neither is the subject, or a small inset of the cabin interior.

gaps.missing: In full focus the building already reaches y≈910, so any zoom or downward tilt from the engine camera pushes the pit into the subtitle band. The template does not compensate; scenes must use camera 'static' (s23_c, s26_b and s32_b now do).
gaps.suggestion: Opt-in subtitle_safe param that, in fixCamera, scales about a bottom pivot (960, 900) and clamps the positive dy for full focus.

gaps.missing: The second engine can only appear on the shaft wall 0,85 s before its rope hit, so between 2,3 and 3,7 s ('das andere stürzt in einen') only the facade cracks are new. The pass-through engine crosses the shaft as a ghost behind the ropes, which a viewer could still read as close to the ropes.
gaps.suggestion: Add debris.enter_at so the shaft engine can fly in from outside through the facade before breaking into the shaft, and optionally a pass_depth cue (smaller scale) for the pass-through engine.

gaps.missing: There is no door-gap anchor for 'Schacht nicht luftdicht', and the 'Luftpolster' leader must cross the counterweight spring buffer.
gaps.suggestion: Add a 'door_gap' part (anchor at the EG door slit where the escape arrows leave) and let air_cushion anchor under the right half of the car when side:'right'.

gaps.missing: location_tag can only reveal its whole text at one time. It cannot show '2006' when the year is spoken (7,11 s) and add 'Tokio' when the place is spoken (8,28 s). Holding the tag for 'Tokio' leaves it on screen for only about 0,7 s before the scene ends.
gaps.suggestion: Allow location_tag.parts: [{text, at}], or a typed reveal with per-segment 'at', so each part appears with its word.

gaps.missing: No beat or label target lets me highlight the landing reference (ruler '0' / Haltestelle level line) at a chosen time. So 'nach dem Verlassen der Haltestelle' (3,27–3,96 s) gets no new visual event after the 1,20 m bracket.
gaps.suggestion: Add label target 'landing' (anchor at the ruler zero / sill) or a 'reference_at' beat that pulses the 0 mark and the dashed landing line.

gaps.missing: The status chip swap 'KABINE FÄHRT LOS' to 'KABINE STEHT' crossfades both texts in the same place, so they overlap for about 0,3 s around B[4].
gaps.suggestion: Fade the old chip out completely before the new one scales in, or slide the new chip in vertically.

gaps.missing: The detect_and_stop layout is not camera-safe. Any push-in moves the top rope brake (y≈94) into the top margin or the lower-left sensor callout (bottom y≈868) into the subtitle band, whatever focus is used. Only static works.
gaps.suggestion: Move the rope brake down about 30 px and the sensor callout up about 40 px, or add a 'camera_safe' layout scale of about 0,95.

gaps.missing: The default zone_label 'Türzone ±0,20 m' shows a number that narration rarely states. Every scene needs to override it manually to avoid unspoken figures.
gaps.suggestion: Default zone_label to 'Türzone' and show the value only when show_zone_value is true.
